lessons.title: Unit 0: Learn How to Read Hangul
lessons.explanation: Learn the Korean alphabet, syllable blocks, consonants, vowels and the combinations needed to read Korean words.
lessons.meaning: HTSK Unit 0 teaches basic Korean consonants and vowels, syllable blocks, final consonants, additional letters and combined vowels. It also recommends moving away from romanization and using Korean audio and reading practice.
lessons.when_to_use: Use this unit before grammar to learn to read and pronounce Korean syllable blocks without relying on romanization.
lessons.how_to_build: Build one syllable block from a consonant and vowel; add a final consonant underneath when needed. Continue with the additional letters and combined vowels in the next Unit 0 lessons.
examples: Combine two vowels into a complex vowel.
Combine ㄴ and ㅏ into one syllable.
lessons.examples_source: How to Study Korean lesson-based sentence practice

lessons.title: Basic sentence structure and 이다
lessons.explanation: Learn the basic structure of Korean sentences and how to make sentences with 이다 (“to be”).
lessons.meaning: Learn the basic structure of Korean sentences and how to make sentences with 이다 (“to be”).
lessons.when_to_use: Use 이다 to identify people and things: “A is B.” It is the basic Korean noun-predicate pattern.
lessons.how_to_build: Attach 이에요 after a noun ending in a consonant and 예요 after a noun ending in a vowel. The noun before 이다 is the thing being identified.

lessons.title: 이/가 and 있다

lessons.meaning: Learn the subject particles 이/가 and use 있다 to express existence, location and possession.
lessons.when_to_use: Use 이/가 to mark the subject and 있다 for existence, location and possession.
lessons.how_to_build: Attach 이 after a consonant and 가 after a vowel. 있다 can mean “exist/be located” or “have,” depending on the sentence.
examples: There is a book inside the bag.
My younger sibling is at school.

lessons.explanation: Use the ㅎ irregular with colors and with 이렇다, 그렇다 and 저렇다.
lessons.meaning: Use the ㅎ irregular with colors and with 이렇다, 그렇다 and 저렇다.
lessons.when_to_use: Use the ㅎ irregular with relevant adjectives such as colors and with 이렇다, 그렇다 and 저렇다.
lessons.how_to_build: When a ㅎ-irregular adjective meets a vowel beginning ending, ㅎ disappears and the vowel changes according to the irregular pattern.
examples: What kind of color is it?

lessons.title: Time expressions and indefinite words
lessons.explanation: Use time words meaning before, after, since and within, and learn indefinite expressions.
lessons.meaning: Use time words meaning before, after, since and within, and learn indefinite expressions.
lessons.when_to_use: Use 전, 후, 이래로 and 이내 to position events in time, and indefinite words to mean anybody, somebody or everybody.
lessons.how_to_build: Place 전/후/이래로/이내 after the relevant time expression; combine 누구/뭐/어디 with -든지 or related forms for indefinite meanings.
examples: I will finish within one month.
